shot_noise: Poisson, R520=0.3 A/W assumed, independent 250 us bins with point-sampled, held gate state; fixed seeds per replicate, rate changes by scenario.
metrics: SINR includes systematic complex error plus noise. Noise-only SNR uses shot + electronic replicate fluctuations around each deterministic contaminated signal; it does not include bias. Null dB means +infinity for zero denominator.
MC_uncertainty: Not propagated; gains are fixed MC means. Replicates vary synthetic photoelectron counts and electronic noise.
